window_geometry.description: Window geometry: [left, top, width, height]. Must be 4 integers. Empty means use defaults.

recent_files.description: List of recently opened log file paths.

max_recent_files.description: Maximum number of entries in recent files list.

search_regex.description: If true, treat search pattern as regular expression.

search_wrap.description: If true, wrap search from end to beginning.

search_highlight_all.description: If true, highlight all matching lines during search.

font.description: Qt font string for the log display. If empty, use system default.

colors.highlight.description: Hex color for search highlight background.

colors.selection.description: Hex color for selected text background.

auto_reload.description: If true, automatically reload the log file when it changes on disk.

auto_scroll.description: If true, scroll to the latest lines when new content appears.

syntax_highlighting.description: If true, apply syntax highlighting for known log formats.

file_encoding.description: Character encoding used to read log files. Supported: UTF-8, ISO-8859-1.
